name: SpecWarp
description: Vital-inspired spectral stretch and smear FX. Pad-held wet. Input is FFT'd, warped in the frequency domain, then resynthesized. X = Stretch, Y = Smear, Depth/MIX = dry/wet.

params.name: STRCH
params.detail: Spectral stretch: remaps the frequency axis (0.2x–8x)

params.name: SMEAR
params.detail: Spectral smear: blurs magnitudes and diffuses phase
